label: Being
resolution: Aquinas draws this distinction himself (ST I q.48 a.2 ad 2). Stage 1 uses only being as the entity of a thing: the domain `Being`, the respect `esse` (DEF-ESSE) and 'maximal in being'. Being as the truth of a proposition appears only in STMT-EVIL-IS-AS-PROPOSITIONAL-TRUTH, where 'there is evil' is the truth (`Holds`) of a sentence. Sentences and beings are different Lean types, so no result can pass from 'evil is' to 'evil is a being' or count a privation as in act with respect to esse. What the definitions do not settle is whether being admits of more and less (`MoreIn esse`) across categories; that is carried by the premises that use the primitive comparative (STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM, STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING), not by the word. Aristotle's many senses of being (STMT-BEING-HAS-SEVERAL-SENSES) are senses of being as entity. Whether being is said univocally or analogically, and so whether it is a genus, is a separate axis recorded in DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY and DISAMB-GENUS. BEING_1 also tags carrier binders (#1832 follow-up, attempt b979db99): the type of beings (Being, B or Entity) of the declarations listed in its lean_parameters, among them the quarta via, Metaphysics II.1 and In Metaph. II readings, the Stage-one and Stage-two premises, GodMaximalCausal, PreexistenceWithoutTransfer and the shared CausalityFrame and GradesFrame, each read by its own module as the beings of that vocabulary. Two carriers so tagged range over the same beings, so truth discover may identify them instead of using the name-only carrier fallback. The tag decides neither which beings actually are (InAct x esse) nor the univocity axis (DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY), and it is not a restriction to bodies or to one series. Untagged carriers remain unknown.
